task.title: Enroll in Duo 2FA
task.shortdesc: Step-by-step instructions for how you can enroll in Duo, NC State University's two-factor authentication system.

context.p: Duo enrollment with your Unity ID is mandatory and follows the same process for NC State students, faculty, and staff. You must have at least one device—such as a mobile phone, tablet, or hardware security key—available before you begin. NC State encourages using the Duo Mobile app as your primary authentication method for consistent reliability.

step.cmd: Go to the NC State Duo Enrollment and Device Management page in a web browser.
Log in with your NC State Unity ID and password.
Follow the on-screen instructions to register your mobile phone, tablet, or security key and complete the enrollment process.
